# Webspace contribution: backward + forward

> Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [Revision Covenant](../docs/REVISION_COVENANT.md). A game feature is not finished when the documentation cannot explain it.

## Scope, owner and baseline
- Base branch/commit:
- Affected world(s), shared asset(s), inherited contracts:
- Linked issue/RFC/previous release:

## Looking backward — what truly changed?
- Shipped behavior and source paths:
- Tests and browser previews actually run (including limitations):
- What was preserved, intentionally retired, or corrected:
- Source/asset rights and provenance changes:

## Looking forward — what remains possible?
- Unfinished promises from earlier construction conversations:
- Next valuable improvements, acceptance conditions, known blockers:
- Who/what can continue this work (Topgro, world thread, any novice contributor):

## Contract impact
- [ ] No shared covenant altered; explain why:
- [ ] Versioned change proposed (portal, screen, flora, sky, privacy, persistence, identity); link RFC and migration:
- [ ] Any custom portal exception registered and tested (if applicable):

## REQUIRED paired documentation
- [ ] README.md includes a **new dated Backwards + Forwards + Not yet + Invariant impact + Evidence ledger entry**.
- [ ] TECH_MANUAL.html has a new technical ledger article with the **same ID and date**.
- [ ] Affected world README/manual, code comments, manifests, roadmap/issues and source links were checked; explain omissions:
- [ ] The source and tests distinguish shipped, prototype, placeholder and aspirational features.

## Delivery
- Source and rollback reference:
- Generated full-screen HTML preview (or reason not appropriate):
- Automated/manual tests passed, failed, or not run:
- Human-review notes and remaining uncertainties:

Do not add a feature to make the checklist look complete. Saying what did NOT change is valuable.
